name: katmer-code
description: Multi-provider AI sidebar for Obsidian — Claude, Gemini, Codex, Antigravity. Per-tab routing, same-tab consult, inline diff, CLAUDE.md auto-mirror, academic research skills.

capability_evidence.mcp-support: Context strip shows real input tokens against the model's actual window (1M for Gemini 2.5 / 3.x family, 400K for Codex GPT-5.x, 200K-1M for Claude).
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI

friction.note_en: Some setup. install via curl | sh installer, global npm install; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure config.json/yaml/toml, OAuth login flow; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。可通过 curl | sh installer、global npm install 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 config.json/yaml/toml、OAuth login flow；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: Multi-provider AI chat inside Obsidian — Claude, Gemini, Codex, and Antigravity in one sidebar, with per-tab routing, inline diff editing, academic research skills, and MCP support.
highlights: Per-model context tracking — Context strip shows real input tokens against the model's actual window (1M for Gemini 2.5 / 3.x family, 400K for Codex GPT-5.x, 200K-1M for Claude).
Reasoning effort — wired for Claude (SDK effort) and Codex (modelreasoningeffort).
In-plugin login — If a provider isn't authenticated, click the picker chip and the plugin runs the CLI's login flow itself (Claude / Codex) or opens Terminal with the right command (Gemini…
Routes per tab to any provider — Claude SDK + Gemini/Codex/Antigravity CLIs behind one ProviderAdapter interface.
